clips.title: The story
paras: Master Gadrin awaits proof that Zalazane has fallen. The Darkspear seek relief from the witch doctor who drove them from the Echo Isles.

Master Gadrin asks for proof that Zalazane is dead. The witch doctor betrayed the Darkspear and seized control of their island home with mind-enslaving hexes. His magic drove Vol'jin's people to the shores of Durotar. From the Echo Isles, Zalazane still sends hexed thralls across the water to seize more victims. Sen'jin Village needs proof that his rule has ended. Returning Zalazane's severed head confirms his defeat and gives the displaced tribe a measure of peace, with hope of reclaiming their stolen islands one day.
